requirements.detail: A personal account, or an organization you administer, to own the OAuth app.
requirements.label: GitHub account

requirements.detail: Up to 10 callback URLs per app. Wildcard matching is a per-URL setting, on only for apps that had a single callback URL before August 3, 2026. If yours has it, turn it off unless you need it; with it off, the redirect URL must match the callback URL exactly.
requirements.label: Callback URL rules

requirements.detail: The temporary code expires after 10 minutes, so exchange it promptly.
requirements.label: Authorization code lifetime

requirements.detail: Expiring tokens: access token 8 hours, refresh token 6 months without use. A refresh returns a new access token and a new refresh token. Check for expires_in in the response.
requirements.label: Token lifetimes and refresh

requirements.detail: The client secret is needed to get tokens unless you use device flow. PKCE (code_challenge) is strongly recommended.
requirements.label: Client secret and PKCE

scopes.note: Opts a sign-in into an expiring access token plus a refresh token.

uncertainties.text: No app review or go-live page found for OAuth apps. The docs read show no review, but this is not stated explicitly.
Client authentication method at the token endpoint (client_id and client_secret in the POST body) was not confirmed on the pages read.
Rate limits for OAuth token requests were not found on the pages read.
Region or data-center hosts: GitHub Enterprise Server and Enterprise Cloud with data residency use different hosts. Not covered by the pages read.
Scope sensitivity and the full scope list were not read.
User caps or unverified-app warnings were not mentioned in the pages read.
Discovery metadata was not found on github.com. This does not mean there is no OAuth.

points.text: Register an OAuth app in Developer settings, no approval step

points.text: Organizations can still block your app

points.text: Expiring tokens are on by default for new apps
points.why: Access tokens last 8 hours and refresh tokens 6 months. Your agent must handle refresh.

verdict.summary: GitHub OAuth apps are self-serve: register in Developer settings and any user can authorize them, with no review step found in the docs read.
